# [TASK] E2E tests: Playwright driving the Filmpire React app against the local stack

## Task

Add a Playwright end-to-end test suite that drives the real Filmpire React app (`frontend/filmpire`) against the local backend stack, exercising the TMDB-facade user journeys at the browser level. Complements the existing API-level Postman/newman smoke test (`.github/workflows/e2e-smoke.yml`, #47) rather than replacing it.

## Scope

- Playwright project lives in this repo (`e2e/`), with a documented way to bring up backend + React app before the suite runs.
- Auth flow (real TMDB redirect) can't run headless — skipped/mocked here; already covered at the API level by #33 (closed).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] Playwright project set up under `e2e/` with a documented way to bring up the stack (backend + React app) before running it
- [x] Test scenarios cover: home lists, genre filter, search, movie details (videos + credits), actor page, pagination
- [x] Cache-hit scenario asserts (via the backend metrics endpoint) that repeat navigation causes no new TMDB egress
- [x] Auth-flow scenario explicitly skipped or mocked, with a comment pointing to #33's API-level coverage
- [x] CI workflow added that runs the suite on a manual/nightly trigger, separate from per-push CI

## Estimate

**Hours:** 10

## Notes

- Completed: created `e2e/` project with full Playwright configuration, documentation in README.md, test specs under `e2e/tests/`, and nightly CI workflow in `.github/workflows/e2e-playwright.yml`.
- Related: #30 and #19 (closed). Reference: ARCHITECTURE.md §10.4.
